title: Negative Page 32 displacements did not support block reversal
claim: Within the frozen first-order GP29 holdout, reversing both blocks predicted by the final two negative displacements ranked third of four and failed both acceptance criteria.
why_it_matters: It closes one precise interpretation without expanding the negative beyond the tested family.
controls: No language optimization or alternate transformations.
limitations: The original model implementation was not preserved, so score regeneration remains pending.
does_not_claim: That negative displacement has no possible predeclared meaning.
That Page 32 has no structural role.
current_interpretation: Reject negative displacement as the exact final-block reversal instruction tested by E1606.
